fields.summary_ko.0: SK hynix Inc. (000660.KS) is headquartered in Icheon, South Korea, and designs, manufactures, and sells DRAM, NAND flash, SSD, and MCP products.
fields.summary_ko.1: Founded in 1949 and renamed SK hynix from Hynix Semiconductor in 2012, the company operates semiconductor memory and foundry businesses.
fields.summary_ko.2: The company supplies products to diverse application markets including servers, networking, mobile, PC, consumer, and automotive.
